description:
Upcoming token unlocks and supply metrics -- which tokens release supply in the next days_ahead days, when, and how much (cliff amounts and USD value). Heavy near-term unlocks are a supply-shock signal. Pass symbol (the token ticker, case-insensitive) or protocol (also for tokens without a ticker) to ask about specific tokens; a matched token is returned even when its next unlock is outside the window. Results are one page of tokens: limit 1-100 (default 25), offset 0-10000; pass next_offset from a response to get the next page. Use it when the user asks about unlocks, vesting or supply overhang.

[Access: pay 0.01 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

days_ahead.description: Window length in days from now. Without symbol or protocol, only tokens with a scheduled unlock in this window are returned.

offset.description: Pagination offset in the result units documented by the tool; zero starts the first page.

protocol.description: Protocol or token name, DefiLlama slug or CoinGecko id, case-insensitive exact match.

rank_by.description: next_unlock (soonest first) or cliff_value_usd (largest USD value of cliff unlocks in the window first).

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.

name: get_token_unlocks
